entities.name: Stephen the Great & Moldavian Golden Age
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Stephen the Great (Ștefan cel Mare, r. 1457–1504) defended Moldavia in 36 battles, notably defeating the Ottomans at Vaslui (1475). He built 40 churches and monasteries, earning recognition from Pope Sixtus IV as 'Athlete of Christ'.
